verdict.rationale: Fireworks documents an official CLI, firectl, used for deployment creation (`firectl deployment create`) and for configuring autoscaling through firectl flags. Its introduction page also references a Nexus CLI for connecting coding tools to Fireworks models. Coverage is thin: missing for 10: installation/auth docs, a full command reference beyond deployments and autoscaling, agent-friendly features such as machine-readable output, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
